title: Architecture invariant test registry and agent provenance evidence

scope_out: must not loosen an invariant's assertion to make a failing test pass; must not implement product behavior — this story adds no loan-platform capability; must not remove or weaken a pre-commit gate to clear the provenance check

entities.name: Architecture invariant test registry and agent provenance evidence

operations.text:
1. Define the invariant registry in `backend/tests/architecture/invariant_registry.py` (new): an ordered mapping from invariant name to the test module(s) that must cover it — policy-version immutability → `backend/tests/architecture/test_policy_version_immutability.py` (owned by E3-S1), the EMI principal/rate/tenure invariant → `backend/tests/unit/test_emi_residual.py` (owned by E9-S3), and the six-layer one-way dependency rule → `backend/tests/architecture/test_layer_dependencies.py` (owned by E15-S2).
2. Add the completeness assertion in `backend/tests/architecture/test_invariant_registry.py` (new): for every entry in `INVARIANT_REGISTRY`, import the named test module and assert it collects at least one test function that executes — covering E16-S1-AC1.
3. In `backend/tests/architecture/test_invariant_registry.py` add the orphan-detection test: register a synthetic invariant with no test-module mapping against a copy of the registry and assert the suite fails, naming that orphaned invariant — covering E16-S1-AC2.
4. Define `backend/tests/architecture/test_agent_provenance.py` (new): walk every production commit on the branch via `git log`, and assert each carries the `Co-Authored-By` agent trailer and a passing record from the standard pre-commit gate set — covering E16-S1-AC3.
5. In `backend/tests/architecture/test_agent_provenance.py` add a test reading the `/gate` attestation record for the head commit and asserting it is present and records 0 hand-written production lines as the NFR-11 evidence — covering E16-S1-AC4.
